method: Real linear least squares for p=lambda_r+lambda_s and q=lambda_r*lambda_s, using the cross-multiplied equation and both real/imaginary parts
gains: Independent nonzero amplitude and phase at each frequency and for each source/readout; amplitude ranges [0.35,1.05] and [0.65,1.95], phases uniform [-pi,pi]
noise_policy: Independent circular-complex entry noise; paired field observations across single/joint-field estimators
diagnostics: real design rank and singular values
unordered-root error conditional on nonnegative discriminant
noiseless charge-only interaction recovery followed by source-class recovery
limitations: Conditional on bare response and the interaction values in the noisy source recovery. Cross multiplication avoids division by noisy axial data but leaves an errors-in-variables least-squares problem; no unbiasedness or coverage claim. Negative discriminants are reported without clipping.
